verdict.rationale: Apple publishes 153GB/s memory bandwidth and a 32GB memory capacity for M5, and makes general claims about running 'larger AI models' and LLMs locally. A 70B-class model, even quantized, does not fit in 32GB, and community comments confirm 32GB is the maximum on current M5 models. Nothing in the evidence shows the platform can practically run a 70B-class model, so this applicable axis is unmet.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a large local LLM (70B-class, quantized) on this platform — enough addressable memory and published memory bandwidth to make local inference practical
